title: 灯泡中的城市
prompt: Create a hyper-realistic, stylish poster featuring a light bulb lying on wet urban asphalt. Inside the bulb, place a miniature version of [CITY] with its iconic landmarks. A sleek white 3D text of the city name ‘[CITY]’ should stand prominently in front of the bulb. The background is a softly blurred cityscape with neon lights reflecting on the bulb’s glass and the wet pavement. Add volumetric moonlight for depth and atmosphere. The image should look like a high-quality DSLR photograph with sharp details, cinematic lighting, and a moody, futuristic vibe.
description: 借助 Nano Banana Pro 模型，打造超现实的城市景观海报，完美适用于未来主义品牌宣传与霓虹摄影项目，突出湿润反射与立体光影的震撼效果。
